tools.name: ean_validate
tools.description: Validates an 8-digit (EAN-8), 12-digit (UPC-A), 13-digit (EAN-13), or 14-digit (GTIN-14) barcode checksum: alternating weights 1 3 applied right-to-left, check digit is (10 - sum mod 10) mod 10.

tools.name: iban_validate
tools.description: Validates an IBAN's length for its issuing country (per the SWIFT IBAN registry) and its mod-97 checksum. Does not decompose the BBAN into a bank code/account number or resolve a BIC.

tools.name: isbn_validate
tools.description: Validates a 10- or 13-character ISBN. ISBN-10 uses weights 10..1 over 10 characters (last may be X, worth 10), sum mod 11 must be 0. ISBN-13 uses the same GTIN checksum as barcodes.

tools.name: luhn_validate
tools.description: Validates a numeric string against the Luhn (mod-10) checksum — payment card numbers, IMEI numbers, and similar identifiers.

tools.name: swiftbic_validate
tools.description: Structural format validation only for a SWIFT/BIC code: 8 or 11 characters (4 letters bank code + 2 letters country code + 2 alphanumeric location code + optional 3 alphanumeric branch code). The country code is not cross-checked against ISO 3166-1.

tools.name: vateu_validate
tools.description: Format validation only (no VIES lookup) for an EU VAT number: checks the 2-letter member-state prefix (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland) against that country's digit/letter pattern. A format-valid result does not mean the number is actually registered.
